senses.gloss:
अत् €1 P. (अति), अतति, अतितुम्, अत्त-अतित
—1 To go, walk; wander, to go constantly.
—2 To obtain (mostly Ved.)
—3 To bind.
—4 (अन्तति) To bind.

आत् The letter आ. ind. Ved.
—1 Afterwards, then; generally used antithetically to यद्, यदा, यदि
 and then sometimes strengthened by the particles अह, उ, इद् &c.
—2 Then, further, also, and (अपि च).
—3 Some-times it only strengthens the meaning of another word or gives
 emphasis to an interrogative pronoun like उ, अङ्ग, नु added to किम्
 (possibly, at all).
